counterfactual_missing_items: vertical supranuclear gaze palsy is not represented in the raw spans
no raw span for autonomic failure that would favor MSA
no raw span for ventriculomegaly or incontinence that would favor NPH
decisive_items: diffuse, generalized hyperintensity of the supratentorial white matter on T2/FLAIR sequences
response.rationale: R6 best combines the raw motor syndrome and raw imaging: progressive gait disturbance, rigid-akinetic syndrome, and diffuse supratentorial white matter hyperintensity. R4 is the closest runner-up because it shares the rigid-akinetic motor phenotype, but it lacks any raw imaging span. R2 uses nonspecific gait and CSF spans plus the white matter finding but does not explain the rigid-akinetic syndrome and lacks a hydrocephalic ventricular span. R1 and R5 rely on cognitive/psychiatric or single motor spans and do not account for the core motor-imaging composite.

rejected.why: CBD is not supported by raw asymmetric apraxia or alien-limb phenomena and does not explain diffuse white matter hyperintensity.
NPH is supported only by nonspecific gait and white-matter/CSF spans; no raw span documents ventriculomegaly/hydrocephalus, and the rigid-akinetic syndrome is unaddressed.
FTD rests on cognitive/psychiatric spans but ignores progressive gait disturbance, rigid-akinetic syndrome, and the diffuse supratentorial white matter imaging.
